scripts.generate: bun run schema && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.push: bun run schema && prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate
scripts.migrate: bun run schema && prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.seed: bun run schema && bun run prisma/seed.ts
scripts.reset: bun run schema && prisma db push --force-reset --schema prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate && bun run seed
scripts.studio: bun run schema && prisma studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.clean: rm -rf generated dist .turbo tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo prisma/schema.prisma prisma/dev.db
